{{Quote|That's not going to hold long. The shunting chips are probably fused and are going to overload any minute.|[[Cecil Noone]]|<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>}}
'''Shunting chips''' were installed in [[Rectenna/Legends|rectennas]] to prevent power overloads. If the chips were fused, they could not prevent power from surging, causing sparks to erupt from the device they were installed in.<ref name="J15" />
